SELECT CAST(first_at AS String) AS available_from, CAST(last_at AS String) AS available_through, effective_seconds, if(isNull(completed_at), NULL, CAST(assumeNotNull(completed_at) AS String)) AS statistics_completed_at FROM ( SELECT min(bucket_start) AS first_at, max(bucket_start + INTERVAL 10 MINUTE) AS last_at, count() * 600 AS effective_seconds, maxOrNull(statistics_completed_at) AS completed_at FROM LQ13_DataGovernance.interface_monitor_offline_daily_all FINAL WHERE row_kind = 'COVERAGE' AND stat_date >= toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND stat_date < toDate(parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai'), 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start >= parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{startTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') AND bucket_start < parseDateTime64BestEffort(#{endTime}, 3, 'Asia/Shanghai') GROUP BY if(toUInt32(#{bucketSeconds}) = 0, toInt64(0), intDiv(toUnixTimestamp64Milli(bucket_start) + 28800000, greatest(toInt64(toUInt32(#{bucketSeconds})) * 1000, 1))) ) ORDER BY available_from
